title: Terminal kinds: only Claude and plain shell terminals are offered; Gemini, Codex and OpenCode are removed
story: New terminals can now only be Claude Code or a plain shell; Gemini CLI, Codex and OpenCode are gone from the new-terminal card's AI Mode list, Settings → AI command lines and the terminal header. Maestro no longer writes or cleans an opencode.json when a terminal starts or closes. Flags saved for the removed kinds stay in the settings file and are ignored.

checks.criterion: The launch card offers only Claude and a plain shell
checks.steps: Open any project, add a new terminal card with Ctrl+T, open the AI Mode list.
checks.expected: Exactly 'Claude Code' and 'Terminal'; Terminal launches a plain shell with no AI tool.

checks.criterion: Settings 'AI command lines' offers only Claude
checks.steps: Open Settings → AI command lines and type --verbose in Custom Flags.
checks.expected: A single Claude tab; Command Preview reads 'claude --verbose'.

checks.criterion: Launching and closing a Claude terminal no longer touches opencode.json
checks.steps: In a test folder with an opencode.json holding {"theme":"x"}, launch a Claude terminal, then close it.
checks.expected: opencode.json is unchanged byte for byte.
